name: Whitney Wheelock
frage: What makes life meaningful after all?
davor: It's not it is, just is. And I came up with like, is-ness. The concept of is-ness. I mean, I don't know if I came up with it, but that was what I was, that what made more sense to me. It's just the is-ness. And that's sat-chit-ananda. It's blissful, and it's such-ness, and it's the absolute consciousness. But it is, it is the blissful is-ness.
danach: So you don't agree that a cute little poodle called Mauro doesn't make life a little bit more meaningful? No. If you're asking me in all seriousness, no, but he certainly reminds me of the meaning. I think it's always meaningful, it's just do we remember the meaning? And she's just experiencing herself. That's the meaning of life.
